title: Program for Alleviating Relationship Trauma and Stress for Intimate Partner Violence - Randomized Control Trial
official: Program for Alleviating Relationship Trauma and Stress for Intimate Partner Violence - Randomized Control Trial
summary: This research study investigates the feasibility of a randomized control trial of a group-based treatment program for reducing stress, trauma, substance use, and use of violence among individuals who were court-mandated to attend a program after committing an act(s) of domestic violence. The study is in a 2-arm design with an intervention group and a control group.
